message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 18 November 2026 10:34 to 19 November 2026 10:34 UTC (16:04 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt, plus the MongoDB ecosystem. Listed versions are inventory clues, not verified installations.

Recent advisories warrant immediate review of NGINX and Ruby. Exact publication times were verified for the Ruby advisory and the CERT-EU NGINX report.

### NGINX: five code-execution vulnerabilities
**CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-123634 and CVE-2026-113425.** CERT-EU reports CVSS 8.1 for each; NGINX itself assigns differing severity labels. Under specific configurations, unauthenticated attackers may execute code with NGINX worker privileges. The conditions differ: HTTP/2, HTTP/3, particular resolver/proxy settings, or mail proxy settings, respectively. NGINX is on the monitored list; versions and configurations need verification. CERT-EU published its report on 18 November at 17:30 UTC and recommends prompt updates, prioritizing internet-facing systems. [CERT-EU advisory](https://cert.europa.eu/publications/security-advisories/2026-022); [NGINX security advisories](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html).

### Ruby: seven Regexp and string conversion vulnerabilities
**GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5, GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x, GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px, GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r, GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w, GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4 and GHSA-pvgc-g7gj-pv6h.** Severity ratings are not stated in the Ruby notice; CVEs were pending. Several issues can permit code execution in particular scenarios; another can expose memory or crash a process. The advisory was published 19 November at 00:00 UTC. Ruby Installer 3.2 is listed in the inventory: Ruby says 3.2 and earlier are end-of-life and will not receive these fixes. Confirm actual runtime versions and application exposure; Ruby recommends fixed releases 3.3.14, 3.4.13 or 4.0.10 for supported branches. [Ruby security advisory](https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2026/11/18/multiple-vulnerabilities-in-regexp-and-string/).

### MongoDB ecosystem
No new MongoDB-family finding was verified within the exact window. The targeted review included MongoDB alerts and searches for server, mongod/mongos, Atlas and services, management tools, Compass, shell, database tools, Kubernetes operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations and libraries. Search indexing and available timestamps limit coverage. [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Possible matches needing review
**LiteLLM, CVE-2026-40217:** A previously disclosed code-execution issue was reportedly added to CISA's known-exploited catalog on 18 November. LiteLLM 1.83.10 is listed, but the exact timing of the catalog addition and applicability to this installation were not independently confirmed. Severity and fixed-version claims differ across sources; review the authoritative advisory and installed configuration before drawing conclusions. [Red Hat CVE record](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-40217); [reported catalog addition](https://tsnmedia.org/litellm-cve-2026-40217-kev/).

**Closing:** Prioritize immediate review of exposed NGINX and Ruby deployments. Search results are not exhaustive and do not establish that other listed products are free of vulnerabilities.
